subject: Presentation details and room check
text: Hello Professor, I am writing to share the event details for next week's student presentation and to note one small technical issue. The presentation will begin in the main seminar room on Tuesday at 2 p.m. and is scheduled to finish by 4 p.m. We will use the shared drive for slides, so any updated files should be uploaded by Monday evening. The room will have a projector, a screen, and a microphone, but the microphone may need batteries before the session starts. I asked the facilities desk, and they said they can bring fresh batteries at 1:30 p.m., although we will need someone to confirm the request in person if they do not arrive on time. I can handle that confirmation, but I wanted you to know in advance. We also plan to record the event for students who cannot attend. The recording equipment is stored near the front table, and I will test it after lunch. If the file upload system becomes slow, we can switch to a portable drive and copy the recordings later. I will label each file with the student's name, the title, and the date. Finally, please let me know if you want the audience to submit questions by card or by email. I can collect them either way and pass the best ones to the panel. If you would like a copy of the room key in advance, I can arrange that after the first session. Best, A student
